title: Refund Tender and One Refund per Reason — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Refund tender rule — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty.** A refund on a tire ticket goes back to the tender that paid the ticket. A ticket may receive only one refund per refund reason.

| Tender that paid the ticket | How the refund is returned |
|---|---|
| Crestline credit card | merchandise credit on the card account |
| Crestline fleet account | credit memo on the fleet account |
| Bank card | to the same bank card |
| Cash or debit | in cash or to the same debit card |
| Exchange-only satisfaction return | store credit |

The refund entry carries the original purchase ticket number and the refund reason it was paid for. A refund is never split across tenders and never paid to a tender other than the original one.

**One refund per reason (hypothetical ticket):** a ticket that has already received a satisfaction-trial-return refund cannot receive a second refund for that same reason.
